claim_boundary: one look at the sealed #109 evaluation split for the frozen #112 v3 unit; grid ranking of 16 fixed candidates per level under the tie-free cost; DESCRIPTIVE intervals; no claim about closed-loop play, other inventories (descriptive) or novelty cells

controls.action_prior: no model (c2.prior_tables, held-out cohort): cost = minus the engine success frequency of the identical action over the fit split's executions in the same inventory (issue-112-v3-retrain-v1/fit-verdicts.json); an action never executed there costs 0
controls.unit_minus_prior: paired grid AUC per (level, seed), the prior value repeated per seed
controls.wrong_anchor: the unit's checkpoints roll the shared grid candidates out from every fit-split anchor (the retrain's anchors-fit.pt, the anchors the unit trained with; v2 held-out definition); per cell: right-anchor AUC minus the mean wrong-anchor AUC, and the mean Spearman of the candidate costs right vs wrong (rank stability)

decision_rule.controls: reported, not part of the gate; the unit - prior contrast and the wrong-anchor right - wrong use the same token rule
decision_rule.descriptive_inventories: offset, angle, power: unit, C*, prior AUC and unit - C*; DESCRIPTIVE only
decision_rule.gate_b: pass iff the unit's pooled grid AUC >= 0.65 and its lower bound > 0.55, and at most 10% of the unit's grid verdict slots are nonfinite (v1 G4); otherwise fail. Grid only.
decision_rule.pre_declared_contrast: unit - C* paired grid AUC per (level, seed); supported iff mean >= 0.02 with lower > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff upper < 0.02; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient. Reported, not part of the gate.

disclosure: Known before the freeze: every #112 v1/v2/v3, #117 and retrain result, and the #104 campaign accounting with its mixed-verdict yield per inventory on this split (grid 311, offset 76, angle 78, power 47). No model output on any evaluation capture has been computed. Hardware: RTX 5090 instead of the #85 RTX 3090. Inputs bind the current bytes after the SERVER_SETUP path rewrite (the #104 plan.json differs from its committed bytes by that rewrite).

evaluation.anchors: per level: E99 batch-1 parse (wlc.encode_carrier) of shot frame 0 of its first complete candidate in suffix order (run_decision_dynamics_retrain.anchor_branches / anchor_carrier), under deterministic_scoring(), parsed after the freeze
evaluation.cells: per level x inventory: its complete verdict-bearing candidates in inventory-ordinal order (run_decision_dynamics_retrain.ranking_cells rule); mixed-verdict cells only (t96.mixed)

excluded.issue109-fit: read only as the frozen fit-verdicts.json (action prior) and the retrain's fit anchors (wrong-anchor pool)
excluded.issue110-*: not part of Gate B; never read

inventories.angle: DESCRIPTIVE only (the 120 levels captured with all 60 candidates)
inventories.grid: Gate B (16 candidates, every evaluation level)
inventories.offset: DESCRIPTIVE only (the 120 levels captured with all 60 candidates)
inventories.power: DESCRIPTIVE only (the 120 levels captured with all 60 candidates)

evaluation.split: #109 evaluation split (issue-109-sealed-cohort-v1 splits.evaluation, 200 levels per family, families ['type010103', 'type010105']), captured by the #104 campaign stream issue109-evaluation; never fitted
evaluation.typed_failures: capture typed failures and incomplete branches are recorded and carry no verdict; never retried or replaced
evaluation.verdicts: engine pig-removal verdict of every complete issue109-evaluation branch from the #104 campaign report (branches.json, #85 channel); rows of other streams are dropped at load

guards.G1_isolation: every scored branch is a issue109-evaluation capture of an evaluation-roster level; every wrong anchor is a fit-roster level
guards.G2_scoring_policy: every record and the anchor store carry the #111 SCORING_POLICY
guards.G3_chronology: plan frozen_at <= anchors parsed_at <= first record scored_at
guards.G4_checkpoint_binding: every scored checkpoint's sha256 equals the handoff
guards.failure: a failed guard refuses publication (no gate value)
guards.validate: --validate re-derives every table from the records and byte-compares the renderings; it re-scores the unit's first seed on every grid cell and re-parses one anchor (endpoint_replication / carrier_replication, tolerance 0.001)

prohibited: changing a unit, threshold, rule or control after the freeze
retrying or replacing a typed failure
question: does the #112 v3 Gate-B unit, retrained on the #109 fit split, rank the candidate launches of the sealed #109 evaluation split: pooled grid AUC >= 0.65 with lower bound > 0.55 (tie-free)?
role: Gate B: score the frozen #112 v3 Gate-B unit once on the #104 sealed #109 evaluation split

scoring.cell_auc: m99.view: P(a pig-removing candidate has lower cost than a failing one), ties 0.5; nonfinite endpoints are excluded rows (typed failures) and counted
scoring.operation: per cell and checkpoint: m99.rollout_endpoints(model, None, z0, actions, t96.arm_spec(request)) from the level anchor to 225 over the cell's candidate actions (v1 endpoint_block for the unit's request only)
scoring.policy: every anchor parse and rollout inside scoring_harness.deterministic_scoring(), in one process that did not train; each checkpoint is hash-checked against the handoff before loading
scoring.pooling: cells are (level, seed) over the usable seeds; the pooled AUC is the mean of per-level seed means; per-seed AUCs use that seed's cells (v3 seed_aggregation)

smoke_evidence.reading: fit split and v3 records only; no evaluation-split anchor parse or model score; the evaluation accounting reads engine verdicts (mixed-cell counts, published by #104)

c_star.role: C*: the pre-declared matched baseline, the continuous-family unit with the largest v3 selection score S (never a Gate-B candidate)
